name: GRANTED: YOUR FUTANARI FANTASY
source:
Leo, a 21-year-old university student, lives a life most men would kill for. Residing in a household full of beautiful women with his foster family, the Millers, he is constantly the subject of envy from his peers. But they don’t know his secret: none of them would attract him. Leo has an impossible obsession, a craving for well-endowed futanari that no woman can match.

During a late-night gooning session, a mysterious popup appears on his screen: ‘You have been granted to live your futanari fantasy.’ Leo doesn’t take it seriously, but still decide to click on it.

The next day he wakes up to a world transformed. Overnight, every woman in the city has undergone an anatomical shift, sporting massive slabs of girlmeat that defy logic. For Leo, it’s a dream come true, but as he navigates his new reality, he realizes that living out a fantasy is much more intense than just watching it on a screen. Can he handle being at the mercy of a city full of dominant, hung women?
translation:
21岁的大学生Leo过着大多数男人都愿意为之奋斗的生活。他和他的寄养家庭米勒一家生活在一个满是漂亮女人的家庭里，他经常成为同龄人羡慕的对象。但他们不知道他的秘密：他们都不会吸引他。狮子座有一种不可思议的痴迷，一种对天赋异禀的扶他的渴望，这是任何女人都无法比拟的。

在一次深夜狂欢中，他的屏幕上出现了一个神秘的弹出窗口：“你已被授予实现你的扶他幻想的权利。”Leo并没有认真对待它，但仍然决定点击它。

第二天，他醒来发现世界发生了变化。一夜之间，这座城市的每一位女性都经历了身体结构上的转变，身上长满了违反逻辑的大量女孩肉。对于Leo来说，这是梦想成真，但当他探索新的现实时，他意识到实现幻想比仅仅在屏幕上观看要强烈得多。他能承受这座城市里充斥着占主导地位、上吊的女性的摆布吗？
